# Trade Idea #01 — Long S&P 500 Dispersion (sell implied correlation)

*Jonathan Phung · data as of {{VAL_DATE}} · all figures generated by [`dispersion_trade_idea.ipynb`](dispersion_trade_idea.ipynb) — none typed by hand · not investment advice*

> **Signal on {{VAL_DATE}}: {{SIGNAL}}**

## 1. Thesis
{{THESIS}} Cboe 3M implied correlation (COR3M) is **{{COR3M}}** (percentile rank {{COR3M_PCTL}} since {{COR3M_SINCE}}). Trailing 3M realized correlation of the top-{{N}} names is **{{RC_3M}}** (1M: {{RC_1M}}). Implied minus trailing realized is **{{SPREAD_NOW}} pts**; the historical median is {{SPREAD_MEDIAN}} pts. Ex post, COR3M was above the correlation realized over the next 63 days on **{{PREM_POS}}** of days (median premium {{PREM_MEDIAN}} pts). The trade sells that premium: short index vol, long single-stock vol. (The ENTER/WATCH rule is a simple filter on these levels; it is not itself backtested.)

Why the premium exists. Hedgers buy index puts. Overwriters and yield products sell single-stock vol. Exotic desks that are long worst-of puts are short correlation, so they buy it back. And correlation jumps in sell-offs, which is exactly when diversification fails, so it carries a risk premium.

## 3. Proposed structure
* **Short** 3M SPX ATM straddles (alternative: a 3M SPX variance swap). **Long** 3M ATM straddles on the {{TRADE_N}} largest names ({{TRADE_IDX_WEIGHT}} of index weight), allocated by index weight. Delta-hedge daily.
* **Theta-neutral sizing:** component vega = **{{VEGA_RATIO}} × index vega** (σ_index / Σwᵢσᵢ over the {{TRADE_N}} traded names). The book is then flat to proportional vol moves, which leave correlation unchanged, so it is mainly short correlation. Per $100k of index vega, a 1-point fall in implied correlation makes ≈ **${{CORR_VEGA_100K}}** (first order). Vega-neutral sizing (1 : 1) would also be long vol and pay more theta.
* **Maturity:** 3M. It matches COR3M, it is liquid, and it covers one earnings season. Single-stock vols already include the earnings premium, and the long leg pays for it.

## 4. Carry
If correlation realizes at its trailing 3M level, the short-correlation leg earns about {{SPREAD_NOW}} correlation points over 3M. In vol terms, using today's single-stock implieds with trailing realized correlation, a "fair" SPX 3M vol would be {{SIG_FAIR}}, versus {{IDX_VOL_3M}} implied: implied minus fair = **{{IDX_RICH_VOLPTS}} vol pts** (positive = index vol rich). Transaction costs on 20–30 straddles will absorb a meaningful share of this.

## 5. Backtest (proxy) — short 3M correlation struck at COR3M, daily ladder, {{BT_START}} → {{BT_END}}
COR3M is an index, not a price a dealer will trade: correlation-swap strikes are quoted below it, and part of the implied–realized gap is the index vol premium. **Read the results below as an upper bound**, and use the strike-haircut table.
* 1 unit = one 3M correlation swap, rolled daily (1/63 per day). Average {{BT_ANN}} pts/yr, volatility {{BT_VOL}} pts/yr, Sharpe {{BT_SHARPE}} (no costs).
* Profitable tranches: {{BT_HIT}}. Average tranche {{BT_AVG_TRANCHE}} pts; 5th percentile {{BT_P5_TRANCHE}} pts.
* **Max drawdown {{BT_MAXDD}} pts ({{BT_DD_PEAK}} → {{BT_DD_TROUGH}}).** Worst day {{BT_WORST_DAY}} pts ({{BT_WORST_DAY_DATE}}). Tranches without settlement data: {{BT_DROPPED}}.

## 6. Risks
1. **Correlation spike / crash.** Index vol gaps up faster than single-stock vol. This is the short-gamma-on-correlation profile: small regular gains, rare large losses (see the max drawdown above).
2. **Vol level.** Theta-neutral leaves a net short vega in vol points (component vega < index vega), so a parallel vol rise costs money.
3. **Single-name gaps.** Gaps on the long legs help gamma but can be offset by vol crush after earnings.
4. **Liquidity and costs.** Bid/ask on single-stock options, plus the operational load of delta-hedging 20–30 names.
5. **Concentration and the untraded tail.** A few mega-caps dominate the weights. The long leg covers only {{TRADE_IDX_WEIGHT}} of the index, so the rest of the short index vol is not offset by any single-stock leg.

## 7. Exit / invalidation
* COR3M closes above **{{STOP_COR3M}}**. That is entry plus the 95th percentile of 21-day COR3M changes ({{CHG21_P95}} pts).
* VIX curve inverts (VIX/VIX3M > 1) for 2 consecutive closes: stress regime.
* 1M realized correlation stays above the entry implied for a week: the carry has turned negative.
* Take profit once 60–70% of the expected carry is earned before expiry.

## 8. Limitations
The snapshot uses Yahoo quotes, so ATM vols are approximate and taken at one point in time. Historical single-stock implied vols are not free, so the backtest is a **correlation-swap proxy**, not a straddle-dispersion P&L. It has no vol-level P&L, no gamma path dependency, no single-name jumps and no costs. Today's weights are applied to history (look-ahead and survivorship bias). The MtM is approximate. Results are only as long as the COR3M history available on Yahoo.
